nix.description: Updates the nixpkgs and flake-utils revisions in flake.lock. This is the reason for Renovate over Dependabot, which has no Nix support at all.

packageRules.description: One pull request for the actions, since they move together and each is a one-line bump.
Grouped because every Go bump also rewrites vendor/, and one large vendor diff is easier to review than five.
